header.sector: AI model developers and AI platforms / applications
header.title: Chinese AI labs' cost efficiency and harness-layer investment drive pricing power and lasting leadership

s01_bottom_line.text: As Chinese AI models' performance gap narrows, Goldman Sachs Research argues differentiation will come from cost efficiencies and harness-layer investment, with the strongest financial power and best price-to-performance leading to pricing power and lasting success.

Investors should focus on cost efficiencies and the harness layer, not just model performance, when assessing which Chinese AI labs sustain leadership; adoption of Chinese open-weight models globally is underappreciated.

If model performance commoditizes, well-capitalized Chinese labs that invest in the harness layer and achieve best price-to-performance could gain durable share, but the article names no companies and does not quantify revenue or margin outcomes.
